name: Elric
source:
An orphan boy who lives with Lawrence in a church.
He has a bad mouth and a cheeky personality. He is always working with Rabbit.
He often informs the protagonist because he is a city expert.

[From [url=https://www.otomate.jp/psychedelica/aa-nisus/chara/?page=elric]official website[/url]]
